data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German word 'bihha', meaning 'a beech tree'. The name Beeck is of German origin and translates to 'small hill'. In some regions, it is also associated with the beech tree. The name Beeck carries the meaning “Small hill” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Beeck usually hope their child will grow to embody small hill and live with faith, good character and purpose.
